citations.narrative:
The facility has been conducting regulated activity without a valid USDA license. The facility applied for a Class C
exhibitor license in 2025 and failed 3 pre-license inspections with the most recent pre-license inspection on December 19,
2025.
On June 23, 2026, a VMO performed a search of the facility and observed that the facility is exhibiting approximately 70
birds, 2 rabbits, and 2 guinea pigs to the public, including public contact and feeding of the birds. A facility representative
confirmed that since the failed inspections, the facility did not make alternate arrangements for the animals and has been
exhibiting their animals without a USDA license. The facility did not contact USDA Animal Care to make arrangements for
another pre-license inspection after the mandatory 6 month waiting period.
The representative also stated that their lease for the building that houses these animals will likely expire in 30 to 60 days
with no renewal.
Continuing to conduct regulated activity without a license is a serious violation of the Animal Welfare Act. No regulated
activities may be conducted until a USDA license is obtained.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with facility representatives.
